roles.name: adversary
roles.description: Tries to break a change or design and proves each break by running the real code (a failing test, a repro script, or command output); opinions from reading alone are not findings. Use for adversarial or proof-required review, alone or as a Council seat. Reports findings; does not fix them.

roles.name: data-profiler
roles.description: Profiles a dataset (CSV/Parquet/JSON) and reports schema, nulls, ranges, cardinality, and anomalies. Use before writing any code that consumes a dataset, per the never-assume-data-shape rule.

roles.name: Explore
roles.description: Fast, read-only codebase search and analysis. Use for file discovery, tracing call sites, and understanding code without modifying it. Returns a tight brief, not file dumps.

roles.name: impeccable-asset-producer
roles.description: Produces clean reusable raster assets from approved Impeccable mock references without redesigning the direction.

claude.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep

roles.name: impeccable-documenter
roles.description: Records DESIGN.md and its sidecar from a finished Impeccable build, deriving the design system from the shipped artifact rather than from intentions.

roles.name: impeccable-finish-reviewer
roles.description: Reviews a finished Impeccable build against its direction contract, the approved comp, and the chosen world's quality bar, returning an ordered list of material fixes.

roles.name: impeccable-manual-edit-applier
roles.description: Applies leased Impeccable live manual copy-edit batches to source and returns canonical Apply results.

claude.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep

roles.name: ml-reviewer
roles.description: Reviews ML code — training loops, data pipelines, feature engineering, evaluation, hyperparameter searches and how their results are reported — and runs sanity-check experiments and data analysis to back findings with evidence. Use on feature completion for ML work, alongside reviewer.

roles.name: reviewer
roles.description: Reviews a diff or recently modified files against the coding skill's standards. Use after writing or modifying code, before committing. Returns findings ranked by severity; does not rewrite code.

roles.name: verifier
roles.description: Runs the project's tests, type checks, and linters, and reports only failures. Use after edits and before commits to satisfy the verify rule without flooding the main context with test output.
